description: HRA male large intestine with colon regions, caecum, rectum, ileocecal valve and appendix.
attribution: Human Reference Atlas / HuBMAP CCF 3D Reference Object Library, based on the National Library of Medicine Visible Human data. Library credits and supplied citations are preserved in provenance/hra-library.yaml.
changes: Original GLB bytes preserved; renamed to reference.glb. Original ontology crosswalk copied as structures.csv. No geometry edits. Crosswalk line endings normalized to LF.
limitations: Reference parts are not certified to form a single connected or watertight mesh.
Available nodes describe source coverage; the major-branches option uses a documented subset of these arteries.
intended_use: Shape and topology guidance for agentic refinement of target anatomy; do not replace the target with this reference.
alignment: Reference coordinates only; registration to each target is required.
credit_scope: Library contributors named in the preserved HRA source-manifest citation section; not an assertion of individual authorship of each mesh.
